bugClass: incorrect regex (over-broad capture group causes wrong singularization)
bugSummary: The -sis/-ses singularization rule's capture group included the stem 'ba', so singular('bases') wrongly became 'basis' (and 'databases' -> 'databasis') instead of 'base'/'database'.
triggerInput: singular('bases') must be 'base' (buggy returns 'basis'); singular('databases') must be 'database' (buggy returns 'databasis')
